_JsonConvention._Note: Read before editing. This file is the single source of truth for all VectorForge configuration.
_JsonConvention._SectionFormat: Config__Domain for all AppConfig section keys (e.g. Config__Canvas, Config__Export).
_JsonConvention._PropertyFormat: Domain__SubDomain__Property for all value keys (e.g. Canvas__DefaultWidth_Px).
_JsonConvention._ValueRules: Booleans: true / false (lowercase, unquoted). Numbers: unquoted. Strings: double-quoted.
_JsonConvention._ColumnAlignment: Align colons at a consistent column within each nesting level — two spaces before the colon.
_JsonConvention._EditingRule: Never hardcode these values in JS modules. Always read via the AppData config loader.
